extras.egress_verbatim: 'Unlimited Traffic, fair usage' on every storage plan. The Fair Use Policy at https://deluxhost.net/en/legal/fair-use-policy states: 'DeluxHost does not apply hard caps or automatic blocks to the monthly traffic of its Services' and 'Monthly traffic is calculated per individual service by adding together all inbound (IN) and outbound (OUT) network traffic generated during the calendar month.' The policy publishes indicative thresholds — the German edition of the same page lists 'Storage-Server: von 20 TB bis 30 TB pro Monat' — so 20-30 TB/mo per storage service is the real number, not infinity. That is still enough for the ~500 GB-1 TiB/day serving load at the low end and for archive bulk transfer at the high end.
